pages.lesson:
LESSON: HOLINESS

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Christian Values
Topic 4.6: Holiness

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Holiness. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why should you lead holy lives as young people?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. describe ways of glorifying God with their bodies
2. recite 1Corinthians 6: on the body as the temple of the Holy Spirit

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. describe ways of glorifying God with their bodies
   In simple words: practise until you can describe ways of glorifying God with their bodies. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. recite 1Corinthians 6: on the body as the temple of the Holy Spirit
   In simple words: practise until you can recite 1Corinthians 6: on the body as the temple of the Holy Spirit. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Holiness using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Holiness in the examples.
2. Explain Holiness to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Holiness.
4. Show that you can: describe ways of glorifying God with their bodies

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Holiness using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Holiness important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. In pairs, read 1 Corinthians 6:19-20 and mention the lessons learnt,
2. In pairs, list sins that do not please God,
3. In groups, discuss how to avoid situations that lead to sin,

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. describe ways of glorifying God with their bodies
2. recite 1Corinthians 6: on the body as the temple of the Holy Spirit

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
